connector.name: Opsera
connector.registryDescription: Opsera AI Agent MCP server providing authenticated DevOps automation over SSE
connector.summary: Hosted at agent.opsera.io over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.opsera, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
